title: Mathematical Universe Hypothesis
content_html:
Mathematical Universe Hypothesis

  • MUH core: “Our physical world is an abstract mathematical structure.” Tegmark connects this to ERH and proposes a computable-universe variant to tame measure problems.
  • Multiverse I–IV: Levels I–III are familiar in cosmology/quantum theory; Level IV equates existence with mathematical consistency.
  • Discovery vs invention: Wigner’s “unreasonable effectiveness” motivates Platonist intuitions, even as formalist views frame math as human-made syntax.
  • Select · Change · Reconstruct: Conscious access (GNW) as selection; mathematics as transformations/symmetries; memory as reconstructive and probabilistic.
  • Critiques: Concerns about empirical testability and scientific method; conceptual worries about identifying mathematical with physical existence.
